title: Nuclear Data Adjustment for Nonlinear Applications in the OECD/NEA WPNCS SG14 Benchmark - A Bayesian Inverse UQ-based Approach for Data Assimilation
reasoning: The paper is strictly a technical study within the field of nuclear engineering and data assimilation. It evaluates mathematical methodologies (Bayesian IUQ, GLLS, and MOCABA) against a nuclear physics benchmark and contains no discussion of religious, moral, or ethical topics.
